_readme: Hero section. `headline` is the page's h1. `statusLine` sits under it; its tones map to theme color tokens: default | bright | heading | prose | muted | subtle | faint | dim | ghost | accent. The index under the hero lists every project whose tier is "flagship" in projects.json, each with its `status` and the host of its demo link, and each row opens that project's case study. `portrait` is the photo beside the headline, drawn as animated ASCII glyphs: put transparent PNG cut-outs in assets/portrait and run `npm run images`, which writes a WebP to public/portrait and bakes a character grid into public/portrait/glyphs. The glyphs take their color from the photo, over a dimmed copy of it; an opaque photo keeps its backdrop in that copy, so cut it out first. Name them in pairs: `01.png` shows first, and `01-hover.png` is what it morphs into while hovered (optional). Pairs show in file-name order, one more per click. Commit public/portrait/glyphs and restart the server after adding photos.
